certified_cases: GET PDF from real paper bytes
Off handoff to rendered native viewer from captured bytes
local file route with explicit File API handoff, rendered gene highlights, decoded hover portrait, and native-viewer byte handoff
firefox.local_file_flow: Top-level file PDF navigation opens the packaged reader, which obtains bytes through one explicit File API selection or drag/drop, never uploads them, and can hand those selected bytes to Firefox's native PDF viewer through a local blob URL.

blockers: Safari WebExtensions expose no response-body ownership primitive equivalent to Chromium mimeHandler or Firefox filterResponseData.
